title: Brooklyn and downtown New York art spaces
text: Six more places in New York: Pioneer Works, BRIC, Smack Mellon, White Columns, The Kitchen and the Center for Book Arts.

title: More of New York
text: Ten more museums in New York: Cooper Hewitt, the Jewish Museum, the Museum of the City of New York, the Neue Galerie, the Noguchi Museum, the Drawing Center, the Museum of Arts and Design, the International Center of Photography, the Bronx Museum and the American Folk Art Museum.

title: New York
text: New York City is our sixth city, starting with the Whitney, the Guggenheim, the Studio Museum in Harlem, the Frick Collection, David Zwirner, Pace and Night Gallery's New York viewing room. More to come.

title: Search by artist
text: Search now reads each show's description as well as its title, so typing an artist's name finds the show they're in, even when the name isn't in the title.

title: Add a show to any calendar
text: Notify Me now works with Google Calendar, Apple Calendar and other calendar apps (a file you download, with reminders built in), Outlook and Yahoo.

title: See one venue's shows
text: Click a venue's name in the list to see only its shows. You can also start typing a venue in the search box and pick it from the suggestions. On the map, the venue name in a pin's popup does the same.

title: Filter by area
text: Narrow the list to a part of town: San Francisco, East Bay, Peninsula, South Bay or North Bay in the Bay Area, parts of Los Angeles like Westside and Pasadena, and districts of Istanbul.

title: Filter by date
text: Find shows that are open today, this weekend or this week, closing soon, opening soon, or on a day or range you pick.

title: Apple Maps or Google Maps
text: On an iPhone, iPad or Mac, the Map link asks which app you'd like to open.

title: Three more San Francisco venues
text: SFAC Galleries (the Arts Commission), Root Division and the Chinese Culture Center.

title: Map view
text: See shows on a map. Pins show where the art is, groups of venues combine as you zoom out, and tapping a pin lists its shows. The map follows your filters.

title: Near me
text: Tap "Use my location" to see how far each show is and put the nearest first. Your location stays in your browser: it isn't saved or sent anywhere.

title: More venues in the Bay Area, Toronto and Los Angeles
text: di Rosa (Napa and San Francisco), MACLA in San Jose, Mills College Art Museum in Oakland, Daniel Faria Gallery in Toronto and Jeffrey Deitch in Los Angeles.

title: Oakland and the North Bay
text: Oakland Photo Workshop, GearBox Gallery, FM Oakland, Johansson Projects, Gray Loft Gallery, Dictée Art & Exhibition and the Marin Civic Center gallery.

title: Notify Me for shows that have already opened
text: Opening day and the full run are offered again once a show is under way, using its real start date.

title: Search ignores accents
text: Typing "Art Mur" finds Art Mûr.

title: Free museums are marked free
text: Museums and art centers with free admission now show the free tag, not only galleries.

title: Istanbul
text: Our fifth city: Galerist, Pi Artworks, Zilberman, DEPO, Elgiz Museum, Rahmi M. Koç Museum, Anna Laudel Istanbul and Borusan Contemporary, with their dates read correctly.

title: Montreal
text: About two dozen museums and galleries, including the Montreal Museum of Fine Arts, with French dates read correctly.

title: A lot more of Los Angeles
text: 13 museums and arts centers and 12 commercial galleries joined the list.

title: Pictures for shows that had none
text: Shows without a picture now get one where we can find it, and pictures load faster.

title: Toronto
text: Museums and galleries including the AGO and the Art Museum at the University of Toronto.

title: Better on phones
text: The list is now stacked cards on a phone. Shows that match nothing say so kindly, and pages look right when you share a link.

title: Add my area
text: Don't see your city? A button on the home page lets you tell us which one to add.

title: Venues with several spaces
text: A venue with more than one space now has a Map link for each.

title: A new logo
text: A painted basil leaf over the i.

title: Art Works Downtown
text: The San Rafael gallery joined the Bay Area.

title: A new look
text: A fresh home page and region pages, and your choice of mouse cursor and effects.

title: Filters
text: When, Medium, Theme and Cost filters on every city page, and every gallery shows the free tag.
